run_relight_visualization: run the relighting visualization script with a config file to generate point light and environment map videos
run_main_function: run the main function with an OmegaConf config to generate relit body renderings as image grids
run_single_light_cycle: run the SingleLightCycleDecorator to render body predictions with a rotating point light across test samples
run_env_spin_decorator: run the EnvSpinDecorator to render body predictions with a spinning HDR environment map for relighting
run_cli_config_override: run the script from the CLI with a config path and optional OmegaConf override arguments
